title: last-distill.json
description: Runtime marker written by /distill after each invocation. Codex writes $HOME/.codex/last-distill.json; Claude Code writes $HOME/.claude/last-distill.json. Read by /distill for same-session dedup and by explicit analysis workflows such as /gather-claude.

session_id.description: Canonical session id at write time: CODEX_THREAD_ID in Codex; CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID in Claude Code, with legacy CLAUDE_SESSION_ID fallback. The literal 'unknown' if none is set.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()). Used by /distill's same-session dedup gate to skip messages older than 2 hours.

metrics.description: Session metrics from distill Step 1b. Values are typically integers (turn counts, file counts), but freeform strings like '$3 (vs $20 plan)' or '~3.5hr' are allowed for diagnostic context. Readers treat unknown fields as opaque.

lesson_count.description: Number of lessons in this run. MUST equal len(lessons).
